name: mining-provider-outcome
title: The mining half reads the provider outcome: the mechanism a preflight failure left in another record
description: The suite measures a diagnostic gap: a provider failure reaches the client but the ledger terminal says host-shutdown-preflight. The mechanism is in the ledger after all, under provider.request records - so the failure reading learns to read them, and the record keeps two vocabularies apart rather than picking one
